proven_vs_held.note: Both agent FIX attempts were REJECTED by the SMT+safety verifier (accepted=false), so nothing reached the proven-vs-held partition. conclusion: The verification layer works as designed with a frontier proposer: gpt-5.6-sol made 2 FIX attempts on the hard residual and the guardrail refused both; every applied fix is the deterministic floor (proven by construction). This is the STRATEGY thesis - DataForge as the guardrail that proves or refuses any proposer's writes - demonstrated with a 2026 frontier model. Consistent with the corrector finding: the frontier model's residual proposals are confidently wrong / unprovable and are correctly not written.
